record.what_it_does: Pipedrive is a cloud-based CRM and sales pipeline management platform that lets sales teams track deals, contacts, organizations, activities, and leads.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 is required for any app listed in the Pipedrive Marketplace (public or private) and is the standard method for multi-user apps; a personal API token (sent via the x-api-token header) is also supported for single-user/integration use but is tied to one user/company and only one can be active at a time.
record.access_notes: Developers can request a free Developer Sandbox account (Developer Hub) that immediately provides client_id/client_secret for OAuth and a test environment, with no cost and no approval gate for building/testing (including private apps, which skip Marketplace review entirely). Production use by real end users requires those users to have their own Pipedrive account, which is a 14-day free trial converting to a paid plan (Lite $14+/seat/mo) — there is no permanently free production plan. Public Marketplace listing additionally requires an app approval process.
record.main_blocker: end-user production access requires a paid Pipedrive plan after a 14-day trial (no free production tier), and public Marketplace distribution requires app review
